proposal.reason: Primary change is a new host one-sided RMA API/subsystem (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal) that is not explicitly covered by a single catalog scope, so `other` is needed. `enqueue` is substantively changed to validate/append new RMA ops and schedule dedicated RMA plans/queues. `copy-engine` is independently substantive via the new CE RMA execution path and signal/wait synchronization logic. `gin` is independently substantive via the new cross-node RMA proxy path, plugin loading, context lifecycle, and proxy progress handling. `communicator` is independently substantive via `numRmaCtx` config parsing/defaulting/validation and host-RMA capability negotiation/reporting in communicator properties and init/finalize flow.
